definition: Gary Bryce Fogel (born 1968) is an American biologist and computer scientist.
details: He is the Chief Executive Officer of Natural Selection, Inc. He is most known for his applications of computational intelligence and machine learning to bioinformatics, computational biology, and industrial optimization.

explainer.lead: Gary B. Fogel is an American biologist and computer scientist.

timeline.what: He received a B.A. in biology with a minor in earth sciences from the University of California, Santa Cruz in 1991 and a Ph.D. in biology from the University of California, Los Angeles in 1998.
